description: Kilometers sporen uitgerust met Railpads 2.0 is a dataset listed in Infrabel open data portal, an open data portal of a railway infrastructure manager, published or maintained by Infrabel. In 2017 lanceerde Infrabel zijn nieuwe Railpad 2.0 als Europese première. Dit is een kleine rubberen zool die tussen de rails en de betonnen dwarsliggers wordt geplaatst en die de geluidsoverlast van treinen met 3 decibel vermindert, wat overeenkomt met de helft van de geluidsoverlast die wordt veroorzaakt door trillingen bij het passeren van treinen. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Infrastructuur. Its keywords are Infrabel, CSR, RSE, MVO. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-infrabel-open-data-portal.
